scope: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI), Census 2011, Jharkhand language tables C-16 and C-17

records.official_title: C-16: Population by mother tongue, Jharkhand - 2011
records.producer: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
records.table_semantics: Distribution of population by mother tongue and sex, separately for total/rural/urban areas at India/state/district/tahsil/town levels; mother tongues arranged alphabetically.

records.official_title: C-17: Population by bilingualism and trilingualism, Jharkhand - 2011
records.producer: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
records.table_semantics: For each mother tongue, the table reports speakers who are bilingual and classifies speakers by two additional languages; data are presented for total areas at India/state level.

provenance_boundary: This artifact verifies official catalogue identities, workbook filenames, table-level semantics, schema fields and relevant row labels only. It does not verify workbook bytes, checksums, worksheets, rows, exact cells or any demographic/bilingualism/trilingualism count. No number may enter CLAIM/EVIDENCE until byte-level acquisition and exact worksheet-row-cell provenance are completed.
deduplication_note: C-16 and C-17 catalogue/workbook manifestations are authority locators within the existing Census source stream. They are not counted as new independent cultural source identities merely because separate tables exist.
rights_and_governance_note: Public official catalogue access does not override MLHKP privacy, cultural-access, community-validation or item-level governance gates. Aggregate Census language statistics are kept distinct from participant-derived cultural evidence.
